Name: Abigail the fish
Author: LavenderHney
Description:
Hello fellow people :D
I was playing Json Shuffle with my friend the other and (almost) everything turned into fish, even my diamond, wich turned into a midnight carp. So my friend said it was an epic~ fish. And so, we made the most logical thing, a shrine dedicated to it! This weekend i started making CP mods (this is my first one!), and so, i decided i would dedicate it to the epic~ fish. So i turned Abigail into a carp! Hope you like it!
